items.q: Mose Allison met us in the next town. And we went on

ctx.x: Yeah. Mose Allison. Mose Allison met us in the next town. And we went on and he oh, man, he would walk all over. And Mose Allison step all on his chest, you know, just talk about him loud on the stage and stuff, man. But he never would do that with me and Jimmy Cobb, you know.
